topic: Bind the peer PID to its connection (proposed SP-011 acceptance item)
detail: NearestAncestor trusts its starting PID; a peer that forks, hands its socket to a child and exits leaves its PID free for reuse under another space's harness. Bound the walk by the accept time, or identify the peer by kernel token (LOCAL_PEERTOKEN, SO_PEERPIDFD). Not found must mean no space, never a default.
note: Settled by the user on 2026-11-10: identify peers by kernel token before enforcement; see D-44 and SP-041.1.a5.
